name: Nami Music 🇲🇲
description: A Telegram Music Player Bot, written in Python with Pyrogram and Py-Tgcalls.

MONGO_URL.description: Get a mongodb url from https://cloud.mongodb.com.

LOGGER_ID.description: Your log group ID, add your bot there and promote as an admin.

OWNER_ID.description: The user id of user whom you would like to add as OWNER.

SESSION.description: Primary assistant Pyrogram v2 String Session from @StringFatherBot on Telegram.

SESSION1.description: Optional additional assistant session. Add more as SESSION2, SESSION3, ...

SESSION2.description: Optional additional assistant session. Add more as SESSION3, SESSION4, ...

THUMB_TOP_TEXT.description: Centered top text shown on generated now-playing thumbnails.

THUMB_CREDIT_TEXT.description: Centered bottom credit text shown on generated now-playing thumbnails.

YOUTUBE_PROXY.description: Optional proxy URL for YouTube search and metadata requests, for example http://user:pass@host:port or socks5h://127.0.0.1:40000.
